loss.expression: sum E||x-g(Z)||^2/(N*d) + beta*(sum E full ascending Plackett-Luce NLL + sum joint KL(q_i||Normal(0,K_i)))/N
loss.reconstruction: one reparameterized Gaussian sample per visit; per-feature squared error
loss.ranking: 16 antithetic Gaussian Monte Carlo samples; full permutation likelihood, no pair cap or pair averaging
loss.kl: analytic joint diagonal-q versus compound-symmetry prior KL
loss.weights: same beta on order and KL; beta=2*sigma_x_squared/d; no extra lambda
loss.minibatches: shuffle subjects each epoch; b whole subjects per batch; divide summed subject contributions by b*N/n_train_subjects
loss.annealing: none; exact specified objective from epoch one

score.implementation: One canonical score_model(model,x) directly returns the float64 encoder mean in eval mode; no decoder or numerical posterior integration.
score.calibration: Model scores remain raw encoder means. Selection uses participant-weighted rank maps fitted only on each fold training set; refit and held-out evaluation use the full-training rank map.
score.interpretation: Expectation of the fitted variational distribution, not a claim of exact decoder posterior inference.
